notes: The core agents improved since the last review: venue validate() now rejects non-finite or negative numbers, the in-process venue agent checks every proposal against its own offer (share, price, capacity, free day) and a deterministic 'day got booked meanwhile' event makes real rejections possible, crew.hired lines are now per hire, transcript amounts read in SOL, and offers.ts makes the venue heuristic pure so the browser, venue agent and keeper share one rule. Tests (20/20, ~17 s) and typecheck pass. The new keeper, however, weakens the safety story the rest of the package is careful about. It holds the demo wallet (fees, venue funding, every simulated fan's ticket) plus seed-venue keys derived from a public seed, and it signs accept_show for any proposal at a seed venue without the checks VenueAgent.onShowProposed applies: no comparison with venueOfferHeuristic, no minimum venue share (the program only requires venue_bps > 0), price, capacity, availability or double-booking check, and it never rejects. Because the keeper's own wallet then buys tickets for those shows, any wallet can propose shows at 1 bps to the venue with a 1 bps threshold and have the keeper pay a band it controls. The deterministic venue keys are documented as demo-only, but they also let anyone sign as those venues. Operationally, the pre-loop funding and registration are outside any try/catch, the workflow pipes through grep so a crashed keeper still exits 0 and the 429s that would show rate-limit trouble are hidden, every tick runs an unfiltered getProgramAccounts over all shows ever created (settled and expired ones included) with no backoff, and FanSim state is lost between runs so each new run first retries purchases fans already made. The browser path also discards the planner's day schedule (book.ts spaces on-chain dates 3 minutes apart), so the rest days, travel days and availability the planner computes never reach the chain. The keeper test covers only the happy path.
issues: packages/agents/src/keeper.ts:94-103: accepts every proposed show at a seed venue without checking terms; run the proposal through venueOfferHeuristic/toVenueOffer and the same checks as venue-agent.ts:137-147 (venueBps >= askBps-200, price >= minPrice, capacity <= offeredCapacity, a sensible threshold, no other accepted show at that venue near that date), and call rejectShow when they fail, so heuristic venues can say no in the cloud as well

packages/agents/src/keeper.ts:118-129: the demo wallet buys tickets for any accepted show, so a band proposing venue_bps=1 and threshold_bps=1 at seed venues gets demo-wallet SOL paid to itself at settlement; cap spend per band and per run, and only simulate fans for shows whose terms passed the venue check

.github/workflows/keeper.yml:45: `npm run keeper ... | grep -v "429 Too Many"` runs without pipefail, so the step's status is grep's and a crashed keeper exits 0; it also hides the rate-limit evidence. Set `shell: bash` (which adds -o pipefail) or `set -o pipefail`, and count 429s in the final stats line instead of filtering them out

packages/agents/src/keeper.ts:58-76: getMultipleAccountsInfo and transferSolMany run outside any try/catch, so one RPC error ends the whole run. Unlike orchestrator.ts:170-171, the keeper does not check venue balances before funding, so a venue whose registration keeps failing gets another 0.003 SOL every 10 minutes; check balances first and wrap this phase

packages/agents/src/keeper.ts:87: `program.account.show.all()` is an unfiltered getProgramAccounts over every show ever created, every 15 s, with no backoff after a failed tick (line 141); filter by state with a memcmp or a dataSlice and back off exponentially on 429/errors. Expired proposals (line 95) and settled shows are refetched forever

packages/agents/src/keeper.ts:126: FanSim's bought/declined sets live in memory and the RNG seed is fixed, so every 10-minute run first retries the same fans' purchases (they fail on the existing ticket PDA and use up maxBuysPerTick); seed `bought` from listTicketsByShow before the first tick

packages/web/src/lib/book.ts:126-128: on-chain dates are now+40min+i*3min regardless of PlannedShow.day, so the planner's rest days, travel days and venue availability never reach the chain, and the keeper (which ignores availability) cannot recover them; map the day index to the compressed clock (e.g. day*N minutes)

packages/agents/src/keeper.ts:52 with packages/world/src/generate.ts:156: venue keys come from the public seed 'greenroom-2026', so anyone can sign accept/reject or take the venue authority on devnet; documented as demo-only in docs/05-architecture.md:66, but say so in keeper.ts and the README devnet section and keep this off any non-devnet cluster (refuse to start unless the RPC is devnet or localnet)

packages/agents/src/keeper-cli.ts:19-23: reads the wallet only as a JSON array (does not reuse keyfile.ts, which also accepts base58) and does not validate --minutes/--fans/--register; `--minutes` without a value gives NaN and the run exits at once with zero stats
packages/agents/src/keeper.test.ts:7-45: only the happy path; add cases for an off-terms proposal (must be rejected or left alone), the low-balance pause, and a failing RPC tick

packages/agents/src/venue-agent.ts:92: validate() now checks finite and non-negative but not integer, so offeredCapacity 12.5 or a fractional minPriceLamports passes and fails later at proposeShow; add Number.isInteger
packages/agents/src/venue-agent.ts:134-135: dynamic `await import('@solana/web3.js')` twice for PublicKey even though it is a direct dependency (still open from the last review)

packages/agents/src/crank.ts:62,78 with band-agent.ts:11: SOL formatting is written three ways (3, 4 and 5 fraction digits); share one lamportsToSol helper so amounts read the same throughout the transcript
